build_hmm_profile_from_stockholm: build an HMM profile from Stockholm format MSA using the Hmmbuild class
build_hmm_profile_from_a3m: build an HMM profile from A3M format MSA by stripping inserted residues
initialize_hmmbuild_wrapper: create an Hmmbuild wrapper instance with a binary path and optional singlemx flag
build_hmm_with_hand_model: build an HMM profile using hand model construction for reference annotation
run_hmmbuild_binary: run the hmmbuild binary via subprocess to generate HMM output from MSA input
